description: This file contains the implementation of the NotificationDriver interface for managing Android notifications within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles notification channel initialization, building notifications, permission checks, and cancellation.

classes.name: NotificationDriverImpl
classes.description: Implements notification management functionalities such as channel initialization, notification building, permission handling, and cancellation for the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: NotificationDriverImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the context and notification manager.

methods.name: initializeChannels
methods.description: Initializes notification channels based on the environment (production or not).

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification with specified icon and title.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification if permission is granted; otherwise, logs a warning.

methods.name: askForNotificationPostPermission
methods.description: Requests notification posting permission from an activity or fragment.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a notification with the given ID.
